full_judgment: 5. The learned Assistant Judge, 2nd Court, Naogaon decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiff respondents. The defendant preferred Title Appeal No. 184 of 1997 before the learned District Judge, Naogaon who by his judgment and decree dated 15.06.1999 allowed the appeal. Against the judgment of reversal the plaintiff preferred Civil Revision No. 1998 of 1999 before the High Court Division and upon hearing the Rule was made absolute and the judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court was set aside.
